complete_logical_context_high_water.aggregation: maximum complete logical input tokens across lifecycle observations

cumulative_fresh_token_churn.aggregation: sum cache-write tokens and uncached suffix-or-miss tokens across lifecycle observations
cumulative_fresh_token_churn.invalidation: count only the later fresh work caused by invalidation

categories.cache_read_tokens: provider-native input tokens served from prompt cache
categories.cache_write_tokens: provider-native input tokens written to prompt cache
categories.uncached_suffix_or_miss_tokens: provider-native input tokens in neither cache-read nor cache-write categories

comparison.dominance: no worse on both token axes and strictly better on at least one

units: native runtime tokens only; never pool unlike runtime, model, or tokenizer identities
unknown_policy: a missing native category remains unknown unless the cited provider semantics permit an exact derivation; negative or overlapping categories refuse
